---
name: Public-health content review
about: Propose or review changes to AQI breakpoints, safety rules, or health guidance
labels: public-health, review-needed
---

## Affected Guidance / Module
- File(s): (e.g., `client/src/lib/knowledge.ts`, `client/src/lib/companion/safety.ts`)
- Evidence level (`strong` / `moderate` / `practical`):

## Authoritative Reference
Link to CPCB, CAQM/GRAP, WHO Global Air Quality Guidelines, or peer-reviewed literature supporting this change.

## Review Checklist
- [ ] Emergency 112/108 guidance remains deterministic and non-LLM
- [ ] No medical diagnosis, drug dosing, or brand promotion
- [ ] Clear disclosure of limitations ("What it won't fix")
- [ ] Accurate English and Hindi (Devanagari) translations reviewed
